FEAT-2-S96.title: Define Specialty Identification Request/Response Schema
FEAT-2-S96.description: Create or refine Pydantic models for specialty identification inputs and outputs, including normalized user query, extracted specialty terms, NUCC codes, confidence scores, and classification groups.

FEAT-2-S97.title: Expose Specialty Identification via Facade/API
FEAT-2-S97.description: Add or update facade layer to expose specialty identification as a callable capability within the FindCare flow, ensuring compatibility with tool_router and agent tool-use patterns.

FEAT-2-S98.title: Validate and Normalize User Input for Specialty Extraction
FEAT-2-S98.description: Implement preprocessing pipeline to clean, normalize, and expand user input (including synonym handling and query expansion) prior to specialty mapping to improve accuracy and recall.
